skill_name: Describe what a "good" digital assistant should be capable of doing.
workflow: A good digital assistant should be able to understand natural language and respond to commands intelligently and efficiently. It should be able to respond quickly to a range of natural language requests, such as basic information, calendar management, navigation, reminders, and task automation. A good digital assistant should also be able to learn and evolve as a user interacts with it, providing better and more tailored responses over time. It should be able to listen, follow conversation topic
